title: Maximize CRS for High-Wage Roles in Canada
discussion_signal: The post discusses proposed Express Entry changes that would give greater weight to Canadian work experience or job offers in high-wage occupations. It also notes that the changes were proposed rather than finalized, making policy uncertainty itself part of the mobility and planning signal.
linked_research_question: How do selection rules and uncertainty reshape occupational mobility and migrant household planning?
limits: Practitioner post, not a population estimate
The post describes proposed reforms and may simplify the official consultation
No causal effect on wages, invitations, or household security is established
